description: Database schema setup: Create SQL migration with profiles, collectes, participants, history tables, RLS policies, and security definer RPCs (get_invite_preview, claim_invitation, pay_participant). Includes indexes for performance and all foreign key constraints.
steps: Create supabase/ directory and supabase/migrations/ subdirectory in workspace root

Create supabase/migrations/0001_init_schema.sql with: profiles table (id uuid PK FK auth.users, prenom text >=2, nom text >=2, phone text unique E.164 +221XXXXXXXXX, created_at), collectes table (id uuid PK, title text >=3, motif enum, total int >0, deadline date null, message text null, created_by uuid FK profiles, history jsonb default '[]', created_at), participants table (id uuid PK, collecte_id uuid FK collectes ON DELETE CASCADE, profile_id uuid null FK profiles ON DELETE CASCADE, prenom text, nom text, phone text null E.164, amount int >0, status enum attente/paye, invite_token text unique, joined_at null, created_at), with all indexes on collecte_id, profile_id, phone, invite_token, deadline

Add RLS policies to migration: enable RLS on all tables; profiles SELECT/UPDATE for auth.uid() = id only; collectes SELECT if created_by OR participant, INSERT/UPDATE if created_by only; participants SELECT if in same collecte via creator or participant, INSERT if collecte creator only, UPDATE if own profile_id or collecte creator; all WITH CHECK clauses prevent reassignment

Add get_invite_preview(token_input TEXT) RPC SECURITY DEFINER: fetch participant by token, check not claimed, check collecte deadline not expired, return {success, collecte_id, collecte_title, motif, amount, created_by_name, deadline} or error {success: false, error, message}

Add claim_invitation(token_input, prenom_input, nom_input, phone_input) RPC SECURITY DEFINER: validate inputs (length >=2, phone E.164), fetch participant by token, check not claimed or idempotent if same auth.uid(), check deadline, check phone not taken by different user, upsert profile, link participant.profile_id = auth.uid(), append history entry 'X a rejoint', return {success, collecte_id, message}

Add pay_participant(collecte_id_input, participant_id_input) RPC SECURITY DEFINER: verify auth, check participant exists and matches collecte, check authorization (own participant or collecte creator), check not already paid (idempotent), generate ref MXP-XXXX-XX, update status='paye', append history 'X a payé Y FCFA', return {success, ref, message}
Add GRANT EXECUTE permissions: get_invite_preview to anon and authenticated, claim_invitation and pay_participant to authenticated only
Document migration file with comments explaining each RLS policy and RPC purpose
acceptance_criteria: Migration file supabase/migrations/0001_init_schema.sql exists with valid PostgreSQL syntax
All tables have primary keys, foreign keys with ON DELETE CASCADE, check constraints, and indexes
RLS policies prevent guests from seeing collectes they don't participate in, prevent guests from inserting participants, prevent cross-user data leaks
All three RPCs return JSON with {success: boolean, ...} structure and handle error cases (invalid_token, already_claimed, expired, phone_taken, forbidden)
Phone format validation enforces +221XXXXXXXXX (exactly 9 digits after +221)
History is JSONB array appended atomically with collecte updates
verification: Read supabase/migrations/0001_init_schema.sql and confirm it parses (no syntax errors visible)
Verify all RLS policies present: profiles (2), collectes (3), participants (3)
Verify all RPCs present with correct signatures and SECURITY DEFINER
Check all tables have indexes on foreign keys and query columns (collecte_id, profile_id, phone, invite_token, deadline)
findings: Migration file created successfully with all required components: 3 tables (profiles, collectes, participants) with proper constraints and foreign keys, 5 indexes for query performance, 3 tables with RLS enabled, 8 RLS policies (2 for profiles, 3 for collectes, 3 for participants), 3 SECURITY DEFINER RPCs (get_invite_preview, claim_invitation, pay_participant) with proper error handling and JSON responses, and GRANT permissions for anon and authenticated roles. All SQL syntax validated by inspection. Phone validation enforces E.164 format +221XXXXXXXXX. History is stored as JSONB array on collectes table. Ready for manual application via Supabase dashboard or CLI.
